units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 4:1:6">Y. Keth. IV, 28ᵇ</cite> <he>עֲמִידַת ב״ד</he> appearing before court (institution of proceedings).
<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:2">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בעדים … בע׳</he> as to witnesses before court, all agree that they must stand.
<cite ref="Shevuot 30b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>בעלי דינין בע׳</he> the parties must stand.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:14">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:3:5">Y. R. Hash. I, 57ᵇ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 19:32">Lev. XIX, 32</cite>) … <he>אני הוא עמידת זקן תחלה</he> I (the Lord) was the first to observe the standing up before an old man (by ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 18:22">Gen. XVIII, 22</cite>, emended instead of, ‘And the Lord was yet standing before Abraham’, v. <cite ref="V00488"><he>תִּיקּוּן</he></cite>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35">Lev. R. s. 35</cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:26">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תרבה בע׳ וכ׳</he> do not stand too much, for standing is injurious to the heart.
<cite ref="Ketubot 111b:1">Ib. 111ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01091"><he>סְמִיכָה</he></cite>; a. fr.; v. <cite ref="J00689"><he>יְשִׁיבָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>עֲמִידוֹת</he>.
Y. Erub. V, beg. 22ᵇ כל ע׳ שעמד וכ׳ as often as he stood before Ahiya his teacher, he considered himself as if standing before the Divine Presence.—2) putting up, erection.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:15">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>המשכן נתקדש בע׳ ובפירוק וכ׳</he> the Tabernacle was consecrated by putting up and taking apart and by anointing.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:13">Y. Yoma I, 38ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>היה שם שבע ע׳ וכ׳</he> seven times was the Tabernacle (at its consecration) put up, and six times taken apart; a. e.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:17">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>אם אין … בסיד אין לו ע׳ וכ׳</he> unless thou puttest sand into the cement, it will not last; so the nations cannot exist without Israel; a. e.

senses.gloss: that part of the daily prayers which must be read standing, usually called תְּפִלָּה.
units: <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 16:12">Treat. Sof’rim XVI, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00119"><he>קָדוֹשׁ</he></cite>.
